questions.question: If (A)/(2) = (B)/(3) = (C)/(7), then what is the value of the ratio (4A + 3B - C) : (A + B + C)?
What is the compound interest for 2 years on a sum of ₹ 7,200 at the rate of 15% per annum, if interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Principal = Rs. 7200

Rate of interest = 15%

Time = 2 years

**Concept used: **

Amount = P(1 + (r)/100)ⁿ

Interest = Amount - Principal

P = Principal

r = rate

n = time

**Calculation:**

Amount = 7200(1 + 15/100)² 

⇒ 7200 × (23/20)²

⇒ 7200 × 529/400

⇒ 9522

Interest = 9522 - 7200 = 2322

**∴ The compound interest is ₹ 2322.**

questions.question: The highest common factor of two numbers is 6, and the product of the two numbers is 72. What is the least common multiple of the two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The highest common factor of two numbers is 6, and the product of the two numbers is 72.

**Concept used:**

The product of the HCF and LCM of two numbers is equal to the product of the two numbers.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

LCM × 6 = 72

⇒ LCM = 12

**∴ The least common multiple of the two numbers is 12.**

questions.question: The measures of the outer dimensions of a closed metal box are given as 15 cm × 18 cm × 8 cm. The thickness of the metal is 1.5 cm. What will be the volume of the metal required to make the box?

Internal,

questions.question: Pipe A can fill an empty tank in 10 h, Pipe B can fill the same tank, when empty, in 15 h, and Pipe C can empty the same tank, when completely full, in 12 h. Find the time taken to fill half the tank if all three pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill an empty tank in 10 h, Pipe B can fill the same tank, when empty, in 15 h, and Pipe C can empty the same tank, when completely full, in 12 h.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10, 15, and 12 is 60 units which can be assumed as the total capacity of the tank.

Pipe A can fill an empty tank in 10 h.

The efficiency of Pipe A = 60/10 = 6 units/h

Pipe B can fill the same tank, when empty, in 15 h.

The efficiency of Pipe B = 60/15 = 4 units/h

Pipe C can empty the same tank, when completely full, in 12 h.

The efficiency of Pipe C = - 60/12 = - 5 units/h [Here negative sign represents that the pipe is used to empty the tank.]

Time is taken to fill half the tank if all three pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty = {(60)/(2)} over (6+4-5)

⇒ {30} over (5) = 6 hours

**∴ The time taken to fill half the tank if all three pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty is 6 h.**

questions.question: There are four people in a family. The average age of these four members is 32 years. The father's age is 50 years, the mother's age is 46 years, and the daughter’s age is 20 years. Find the age of the only son in the family.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There are four people in a family. The average age of these four members is 32 years. 

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Total age of family = 32 × 4

⇒ 128

Now,

Age of the son = 128 - 50 - 46 - 20

⇒ 12 years

**∴ The age of the only son in the family is 12 years.**

questions.question: The profit earned on selling a bike for ₹ 68,250 is the same as the loss incurred on selling the bike for ₹ 47,250. Find the cost price of the bike.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the profit earned on selling an article is exactly equal to the loss incurred, the Cost Price (CP) is simply the average of the two selling prices.

CP = (SP₁ + SP₂) ÷ 2

CP = (68250 + 47250) ÷ 2

CP = 115500 ÷ 2 = 57750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 57,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price with profit (SP₁) = ₹ 68,250

Selling Price with loss (SP₂) = ₹ 47,250

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4583e1dea2de780f3534e02f43013abc191003ff65c221c28fff763d0b860f72.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Loss = CP − SP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit = Loss

⇒ 68250 − CP = CP − 47250

⇒ CP + CP = 68250 + 47250

⇒ 2 × CP = 115500

⇒ CP = 115500 ÷ 2

⇒ CP = 57750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 57,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price (CP) & Selling Price (SP)

When an article is sold at a gain, SP > CP. The difference is Profit = SP − CP. When it is sold at a loss, CP > SP. The difference is Loss = CP − SP.

When Profit equals Loss

If the profit made by selling an article at SP₁ is exactly equal to the loss incurred by selling it at SP₂, then the Cost Price (CP) is the arithmetic mean of the two selling prices. CP = (SP₁ + SP₂) ÷ 2.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Both profit and loss percentages are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated otherwise. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

questions.question: A student has to obtain a minimum of 50% marks in an examination to pass. He scored 40% and failed by 30 marks. Find the total marks of the examination.
questions.solution:

A student has to obtain a minimum of 50% marks in an examination to pass.

He scored 40% and failed by 30 marks.

50% - 40% = 30

⇒ 10% = 30

⇒ 1% = 3

⇒ 100% = 300

So, the total numbers = 300

questions.question: Three pipes, D, E, and F, can fill a tank in 6 min, 8 min and 12 min, respectively. All the pipes are opened simultaneously, and then pipes D and E, are closed 3 minutes before tank is full. In how much time will the tank be full?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three pipes, D, E, and F, can fill a tank in 6 min, 8 min and 12 min

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Let's assume the tank will be full in 'y' min.

Three pipes, D, E and F, can fill a tank in 6 min, 8 min and 12 min, respectively.

LCM of 6, 8 and 12 is 24 units which can be assumed as the total capacity of the tank.

Efficiency of pipe D = 24/6 = 4 units/min

Efficiency of pipe E = 24/8 = 3 units/min

Efficiency of pipe F = 24/12 = 2 units/min

All the pipes are opened simultaneously, and then pipes D and E are closed 3 minutes before tank is full.

According to the question,

4 × (y − 3) + 3 × (y − 3) + 2 × y = 24

⇒ 4y − 12 + 3y − 9 + 2y = 24

⇒ 9y - 21 = 24

⇒ 9y = 24 + 21

⇒ 9y = 45

⇒ y = 5

So the tank will be full in 5 min.

**∴ The required answer is 5 min.**

questions.question: Shital covers a certain distance in 9 hours at the speed of 40 km/h. If she wants to cover the same distance in 6 hours, then by how much will she have to increase her speed (in km/h)?

To cover this in 6 hours her speed will be = 360/6
